subject: Reasoning
topic: Ordering and Sequence — Arrange in Correct Order (Set W7)

questions.stem:
Arrange the following in correct increasing order of linguistic unit size:
A) Word   B) Letter   C) Sentence   D) Paragraph
questions.explanation: C is correct. Correct order from smallest to largest linguistic unit: Letter → Word → Sentence → Paragraph. A letter forms a word, words form a sentence, sentences form a paragraph.

questions.stem: What day of the week comes 3 days AFTER Wednesday?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Wednesday + 1 = Thursday. Thursday + 1 = Friday. Friday + 1 = Saturday. Three days after Wednesday = Saturday.

questions.stem: If Monday is the 1st day of the week, what is the 5th day?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday. The 5th day of the week starting from Monday is Friday.

questions.stem:
Arrange in correct chronological order:
A) Bronze Age   B) Stone Age   C) Iron Age   D) Space Age
questions.explanation: A is correct. Chronological order: Stone Age (prehistoric, ~3.3 million years ago) → Bronze Age (~3300 BCE) → Iron Age (~1200 BCE) → Space Age (from 1957, Sputnik). B → A → C → D.

questions.stem: Which month comes 3 months AFTER September?
questions.explanation: C is correct. September → October (+1) → November (+2) → December (+3). Three months after September = December.

questions.stem:
Arrange in correct ascending order of time duration:
A) Week   B) Day   C) Year   D) Decade
questions.explanation: D is correct. Day (1 day) → Week (7 days) → Year (365 days) → Decade (10 years). B → A → C → D.

questions.stem:
Arrange in correct biological classification order from broadest to most specific:
A) Genus   B) Kingdom   C) Family   D) Species
questions.explanation: B is correct. Broadest to most specific: Kingdom → Phylum → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species. Among the given options: Kingdom (B) → Family (C) → Genus (A) → Species (D). Memory: King Philip Came Over For Good Sex.

questions.stem:
Arrange in alphabetical order: Brain, Branch, Brave, Bread.
Which word comes FIRST in a dictionary?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Compare 3rd letter first: Brain/Branch/Brave all have 'a' as 3rd letter; Bread has 'e'. Since 'a' < 'e', all Bra- words come before Bread. Among Brain, Branch, Brave: compare the 4th letter: Brain='i', Branch='n', Brave='v'. Alphabetical order: i < n < v. Final order: Brain → Branch → Brave → Bread. Brain comes first in the dictionary.

questions.stem:
Arrange in chronological order of establishment:
A) Indian National Congress (INC)   B) SEBI   C) Reserve Bank of India (RBI)   D) World Trade Organization (WTO)
questions.explanation: A is correct. Founding years: INC = 1885, RBI = 1935, SEBI = 1992, WTO = 1995. Chronological order: INC (A) → RBI (C) → SEBI (B) → WTO (D) = A → C → B → D.

questions.stem:
Arrange in ascending order of distance from the Sun:
A) Jupiter   B) Earth   C) Saturn   D) Mars
questions.explanation: B is correct. Average distance from Sun: Earth (~150M km, 3rd planet), Mars (~228M km, 4th), Jupiter (~779M km, 5th), Saturn (~1,430M km, 6th). Order nearest to farthest: Earth → Mars → Jupiter → Saturn = B → D → A → C.
